content.value_statement: Influencer budget planning is difficult when rates, platforms, and campaign goals compete. This skill turns budget inputs into allocations, projections, and scenario comparisons.
actual_capabilities: Allocates budget across influencer tiers, platforms, content types, gifting, amplification, tools, and contingency.
Applies built-in benchmark ranges for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube creator costs.
Compares conservative, recommended, and aggressive budget scenarios side by side.
Projects reach, impressions, engagements, CPM, CPE, CPV, CPC, EMV, ROI, and ROAS when inputs allow.
Labels metrics as measured, user-provided, or estimated for clearer decision support.
Recommends mid-campaign reallocations from underperformers to stronger performers when performance data is provided.
limitations: It does not negotiate rates or contact creators.
Benchmark rates are estimates and need validation with actual creator quotes.
ROI and ROAS projections depend on the quality of user-provided conversion data.
Live pacing reads and bid strategy decisions belong to separate paid media skills.

use_cases.title: Plan a Product Launch Budget
use_cases.description: Build a funded creator mix before outreach begins.

use_cases.title: Compare Client Budget Scenarios
use_cases.description: Compare conservative, recommended, and aggressive budgets for approval.

use_cases.title: Reallocate Live Campaign Spend
use_cases.description: Move remaining spend from weak creators to stronger performers during a campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Budget Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Allocate a $30,000 influencer budget for Instagram and TikTok. The goal is awareness for a skincare launch targeting Gen Z.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Budgets
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare $50,000 and $100,000 influencer budget scenarios for a fitness app launch. Show tier mix, reach, CPM, and tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize With Constraints
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize a $75,000 creator budget for YouTube and Instagram. Include at least 20 creators and spend no more than $5,000 per creator.

prompt_templates.title: Reallocate Mid Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: We spent $42,000 of an $80,000 plan. Recommend reallocations using this data: creator A beat CPM target, creator B missed engagement target, and TikTok outperformed Instagram.

output_examples.input: A $30,000 skincare launch needs Instagram and TikTok coverage for Gen Z awareness.
output: Recommended split: TikTok influencers 50%, Instagram influencers 30%, amplification 15%, and contingency 5%.
Influencer mix: micro and nano creators to balance reach, content volume, and cost control.
Projected results include estimated reach, engagements, CPM, and ROI with clear assumption labels.

output_examples.input: An agency needs conservative, recommended, and aggressive options for a $100,000 client budget.
output: The skill compares tier mix, creator count, expected reach, projected CPM, and risk level across all scenarios.
It names one recommended scenario and explains why it best fits the campaign goal.

output_examples.input: A live campaign has uneven creator results and half the budget still unspent.
output: The skill compares actual performance against plan and identifies top performers and underperformers.
It recommends moving remaining budget toward creators, platforms, or formats with stronger cost efficiency.

best_practices: Provide total budget, timeline, goal, target audience, and required platforms before asking for allocation.
Separate fixed costs from influencer spend so projections use the correct available budget.
Ask the skill to label measured, user-provided, and estimated values in every projection.
anti_patterns: Do not request exact ROI without conversion data or stated assumptions.
Do not allocate the full budget to one creator unless concentration risk is acceptable.
Do not use benchmark rates as final contracted rates without creator confirmation.

faq.question: Does this skill contact influencers?
faq.answer: No. It creates the budget plan. Use an outreach skill after the allocation is approved.

faq.question: Can it use real creator rates?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide rate cards or connector data to replace benchmark estimates.

faq.question: Does it require live integrations?
faq.answer: No. It can work from user-provided budgets, goals, platforms, and benchmark tables.

faq.question: Can it compare budget scenarios?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare conservative, recommended, and aggressive scenarios.

faq.question: Can it plan paid ad spend?
faq.answer: It can create a paid-ad allocation plan, but live pacing and bid strategy are out of scope.

faq.question: How accurate are the projections?
faq.answer: Accuracy depends on input quality. Measured rates and past campaign data improve projections.
